variants.after: Below the slate edge, the faint but frantic ringing of alarm bells rises from the courtyard; the grandmaster's lock you forced open on the undervault has drawn a swarm of furious watchmen.
Sable crouches low against a soot-stained chimney, muttering that the street patrols look twice as thick because the panicked almoner you spared has surely sung your description to the Guard.

Your hands remain perfectly steady against the freezing steel, hardened by the brutal thud of the almoner plummeting to the cobbles earlier tonight; one more broken thing will hardly trouble your stained conscience.
The stiff, coarse canvas of your porter's livery scrapes loudly against the narrow brick walls, a heavy and stifling garment that makes it difficult to bend your knees before the forbidding ironwork.

Leaving the shattered grandmaster's lock exposed downstairs was a necessary risk, but the brazen trail of forced steel you left behind explains exactly how their agents traced your movements to this room.

Armed with the damning evidence from the sealed counter-ledgers, you trace the matching strokes of handwriting with grim satisfaction, understanding perfectly well that Matron Rigg and Lord Valerius share the very same inkwell.
